verdict.rationale: A government business-registry service could plausibly publish a filing or records API, so the API-parity axis applies. Every documented capability (LLC and corporation formation, annual reports, officer, agent and address changes, reinstatement, dissolution, certificates, status lookup) is described only as online filing through a browser-based web application or as print-and-mail forms. The pack contains no evidence of any public API, let alone one matching the UI.
